title: Adjoint Reidemeister torsion from hyperbolic gluing equations
summary: Motivated by the study of asymptotics of quantum invariants, Dimofte and Garoufalidis introduced a power series associated to a suitable ideal triangulation of a cusped hyperbolic $3$-manifold. They proved that its constant term can be written in terms of Neumann-Zagier data and the complex shape parameters of ideal tetrahedra, and conjectured that it equals the adjoint twisted Reidemeister torsion.
